selection_objective: Maximize the worst of two reference-fold pairwise ranking-margin predicted improvements, subject to grounding predicted improvement not below min(0, baseline prediction). Predictions simulate actual clipped AdamW updates from the current optimizer state.
execution_scope: Selected mixture is sampled for every update in the following 128-step window. One-step reference predictions do not certify future-window performance.
checkpoint_rule: Highest tuning NDCG@10; same checkpoint for all final metrics. Calibration audit never selects checkpoints.
primary_outcome: Paired development NDCG@10 difference on 4096 calibration users at the selected checkpoint; report Recall@10, grounding, total wall time, actual tokens, query cost and unique training positions. Atoms must also improve over raw_window before claiming their contribution.
evidence_scope: Development experiment, not final test or external reproduction. Prior E003 gate remains failed; this is a newly authorized training hypothesis with corrected execution and evaluation.
resource_policy: Start only on free authorized GPU5/6, one process per GPU. Release immediately after a run; no idle memory reservation. Queue remaining methods automatically.
